notes: Account summary: mid-stage fintech B2B platform; heavy search across transaction records, contracts, and customer support transcripts; building RAG layer for analysts + riskOps.
Primary pain: current pgvector setup at scale is brittle for mixed workloads (ingest spikes + heavy fanout queries) — looking for predictable latency and cost model.
Scale targets: initial index ~120M vectors (embed size 1536), expected growth to ~1B vectors in 12-24 months; cold storage + hot index tiering desired.
Query profile: 250 QPS peak (spiky), median query is retrieval-only but A/B ~20% require reranking; target end-to-end p95 latency for retrieval + rerank = <=200ms, p99 goal 400ms.
Cost sensitivity: internal threshold <$0.002 per query (avg) including retrieval + rerank — procurement will push back if cost higher.

Vector DB preferences: prefer managed Pinecone for hosted path, but must support pgvector for on-prem deployments. Also evaluating Weaviate for semantic filters. Elastic hybrid search used for legacy BM25 fallback.

Connector requirements (explicit asks): streaming/upsert idempotency, incremental delta ingestion (CDC), backfill tooling for bulk load (100M+ vectors), per-record metadata predicates, strong filtering (tenant_id + pii_flags), vector + metadata consistency guarantees, TTL/deletion propagation, configurable batch size and concurrency, and metrics for ingest lag.

Latency / routing: need route-by-policy to hot vs cold islands; support for pinning specific model variants for reranker to dedicated GPUs; automated fallback to cheaper model when latency budget breached.

Retrieval + Rerank architecture preferences: hybrid retrieval (BM25 + ANN), top-K=100 recall step, cross-encoder reranker at top-10; reranker budget <120ms added latency — evaluating Redwood Dedicated for colocated reranker GPU pool to meet SLOs.

Evaluation plan / POC: propose 6-week POC. Phase 1: ingest 15M vectors (real transaction docs) into Pinecone managed + pgvector on private k8s; run A/B retrieval quality + latency. Phase 2: add Redwood cross-encoder reranker via Dedicated instance; measure p95/p99 and cost.

Security and compliance: must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logs export to SIEM, and option for data residency in US-Fed region. On-prem install must be air-gapped friendly for a future regulated client vertical.

Integration checklist requested from Helix: connector spec (API endpoints, idempotent upsert contract), network egress estimates, sample ingestion throughput numbers, cost model by QPS and vector size, replication/HA design.
Quotes from stakeholders: 'If p99 spikes beyond 500ms we will see agent churn' — Head of Risk. 'We need tight control of egress costs before committing to managed' — Infrastructure lead.
Procurement notes: budget owner prefers annual committed Dedicated capacity if unit economics meet targets; procurement needs a pricing deck and example ARR comparison vs current spend.
Recent activity: 2026-02-15 discovery call (intro use cases), 2026-03-05 technical deep-dive (ingest/pgvector pain), 2026-03-09 internal POC sync with SEs (scope agreed).

Open questions for Redwood: do you have an official pgvector connector with incremental CDC? What are realistic Dedicated latency numbers for cross-encoder rerank at 10 QPS? Can Optimize produce batching/quantization recommendations for their workload?
